ConnectionStrings.//Meta: landbridge-meta's OWN Postgres (spec §3). Separate from any instance's database. Override via LANDBRIDGE_META_DB. Defaults to Host=localhost;Database=landbridge_meta;Username=landbridge.

Meta.//Operator: Operator auth for the panel (design note §5). Human-only, separate credential class from the plane.

Operator.//PassphraseHash: SHA-256 hex of the meta operator passphrase. Store the HASH, never the plaintext. When unset the login door is fail-closed (503). Generate e.g.: printf '%s' 'your-passphrase' | shasum -a 256.

Meta.//Secrets: At-rest encryption for the secrets meta RETAINS to re-inject on resume/upgrade: instance database passwords, relay bearers, and host mTLS client keys (task #79).

Secrets.//Keys: Ordered AES-256 master keys, base64, 32 bytes each. Element 0 is the PRIMARY and seals new values; the rest are retired keys kept only so existing rows still decrypt. Meta REFUSES TO START when this is empty — it will not fall back to plaintext. Generate: openssl rand -base64 32. Back up the key alongside the database: losing either strands every instance's resume/upgrade. Rotation procedure in docs/META.md.

Meta.//Domain: Base domain instances publish under: instance 'foo' → foo.landbridge.<Domain> (MCP) and relay-foo.landbridge.<Domain> (relay). Wildcard DNS + Caddy TLS are operator prerequisites (docs/META.md).
Meta.//McpImageRepo: Image repositories (no tag). An instance's ImageTag is appended: {McpImageRepo}:{tag} and {RelayImageRepo}:{tag}.
Meta.//DefaultImageTag: Tag a create pins when it names none. Empty = no default, and a create without a tag is rejected: nothing publishes 'latest', and a mutable tag would never be re-pulled (EnsureImageAsync short-circuits on a locally-present image). Set this to a published tag — prefer an immutable sha-<commit> one.
Meta.//CaddyAdminUrl: The edge Caddy admin API base (design note §4). Meta manages route entries within an operator-established base config.
Meta.//MigrateOnStartup: Apply meta's OWN migration to its OWN store at startup (dev convenience). Unrelated to the per-instance Landbridge:MigrateOnStartup meta injects into instances.
